text:
Erfurt’s median asking rent stands at 10.0 €/m² in June 2026, up 6.7 % year‑on‑year and 26.6 % over the past five years, placing the city 23rd of the 37 most expensive markets. The market is described as balanced, with a vacancy rate of 2.5 % and an average of 29 days on market; 24 % of listings are let within a week.

Affordability remains moderate: a 60 m² unit costs about 600 €/month, generating a rent‑burden of 14.2 % for two residents. Asking rents are roughly 54 % above the 2022 existing‑rent level of 6.48 €/m², reflecting a premium in a tight supply environment.

The model estimate forecasts the median asking rent to reach 10.41 €/m² in the next 12 months, with a range of 10.02 – 10.71 €/m², implying a 4.2 % increase.
